description: The setKeyboard() guard rejects rows via isEmptyRow() on THREE conditions (null row, null buttons(), empty buttons()), but the test setKeyboard_nullOrEmptyRows_failsTerminally only exercises the top-level null/empty keyboardRows list. The 'row with null/empty buttons' branch of the guard (rows.stream().anyMatch(isEmptyRow)) has no direct unit coverage. Edge-case note 105 in the task explicitly calls this path out ('A row record with a null/empty buttons list ... do not silently emit an empty wire row'). It is implemented but untested.
recommendation: Add a case to the guard test: a SET_KEYBOARD step whose keyboardRows contains a valid row plus one row with an empty/null buttons list, asserting FAIL + 'empty_keyboard_rows' + sender never called. Cheap to add given the existing row()/setKeyboardStep helpers.
